cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

mechanism: A uses precise guest-service corrections to keep B discussing cutlery and towels instead of the kitchen cleaning A failed to do.
confusable: D14 avoids a subject generally; D38 specifically needs a larger practical responsibility A avoided, visible beneath the minor-detail diversion.
comparison: Packing alternative focuses on label design before filling boxes; kitchen scene turns offered cleaning help into guest-towel specifications.
seedUse: Spoon, unclean kitchen and visiting Mum gloves derive from D38-a; S03 adds polishing and linen corrections that sustain the minor-detail diversion.
